text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeeeeeaaaaaaah!! Hype it up to the max! 
Let's freaking goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kh... I won't let you! Show 'em your grit, 
Bamboo Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Helios-san, Bamboo-san... You're both 
dazzling. But—)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You are the culmination of our 
'Illustrious Lineage,' possessing speed 
second to none—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —That brilliance... I won't give it up...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

—The winner is Daiichi Ruby! The spring 
mile champion shows off a magnificent 
transformation— it's Daiichi Ruby of the 
"Splendid Clan"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what was that run just now!? Daiichi 
Ruby is... so faaaast!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she had turned into light... 
......So this is the 'Illustrious 
Lineage'—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —...Yes. This is it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(This speed that captivates everyone is 
the ultimate brilliance. And...—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(The reason why my clan seeks it. That 
reason, too...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ruby! You... run like that?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It stings, but... the fastest one out 
there today was you."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Next time won't be so easy, though! I've 
got my pride on the line too, you know...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll surpass that speed too, just you 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—Why pursue speed? It is not merely to 
claim first place in a race.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (—Duty.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(The fastest Umamusume dashes ahead of 
everyone else. Showing her back to all, 
she leads the way at the front.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Everyone aims for that brilliant light.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(To be that light is the duty of the 
"Illustrious Clan" standing above the 
people—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...What a sublime, noble light.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I want to reach that place too...!

The expression on Daiichi Ruby's face 
right after the race was brimming with a 
bright radiance she had never shown 
before.

A sharp, ice-like gleam... That's what she 
possessed until now. But now, it's as if 
light emanates from her very flesh and 
blood... shining from within.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Regarding our next goal, please let me 
know if you have any suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe... there is only one option, 
however.

I felt the exact same way. A race where 
she could make full use of her brilliant 
late kick once again today... That would 
be the one to decide the fastest 
Umamusume—
choice_data_list: Let's head for the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If it is there, perhaps I... will be able 
to reach even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
These incredible contenders— my rivals, 
will elevate me to new heights.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To let no one pass... Driven by that sense 
of duty.

"Remembering how she looked before the 
race, and that brilliance she showed just 
a moment ago—it slipped out naturally."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... that might be the case.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Heliooos! Everyone else has already 
moved on, you know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...This is so bad.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
――Ojousama, that was sooooo fire! I'm 
like, legit head over heels...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What is this, my heart's racing way too 
hard!! It's totally a demon-level 
festival!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ................Alright! Deciiided☆

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: U-Umm...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I was planning on running the Spring 
S!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But I'm stopping! Wonder why?!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Umm—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Cuz I want you to fall for me while my 
vibes are totally peak☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna polish myself up in the Gâ ¡s 
and become the ultimate party animal-! !

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —"Wait for me at the Mile CS, milady!"

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Um, could you please move...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Miracle-san is also scheduled to run in 
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

A few days after the Yasuda Kinen, I heard 
that K.S. Miracle's preparations for the 
Sprinters Stakes were progressing 
smoothly.

In the six months since her debut, she has 
set course records... and right now, it 
seems she's honing that speed even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Do you have the materials on Miss 
Miracle?
choice_data_list:
They said they're about to run a mock race 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, allow me to observe. —To 
learn the depth of her speed."

"—The winner is Daiichi Ruby! The spring 
mile champion shows off a brilliant 
transformation, Daiichi Ruby of the 
'Splendid Clan'!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how many times I see it, it's 
amazing.

"In the post-race press conference, it was 
announced that her next target race will 
be the Sprinters Stakes. Eyes will be on 
her even more going forward."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I have to run. I have to surpass her 
right now...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That race is the one thing... I cannot 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Miracle~! The race is starting!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —I'm coming.

Coming to watch K.S.Miracle's mock race, a 
tremendous shock awaited me. Accelerating 
in an instant, she pulled away from 
everything—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "This speed is... This radiance is—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What I seek is...

Daiichi Ruby muttered as if in a daze. Her 
words trailed off, but she seemed to have 
discovered something in K.S. Miracle's 
running.

Two runners with magnificent speed 
clashing in the Sprinters Stakes... I had 
a premonition it would be an incredible 
race—
